title: Maintainer action: run one door-mode scenario round at five repetitions per arm and file it as an eval-run (split from #34780)
body:
sweep#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYJqoPAoSpWTMpH1yq

Source: maintainer — Warren, 2026-11-19 00:32Z in the objectstack priorities discussion thread: 「可以拆的都同意。」 (the split list's item 2: move #34780's door-mode eval round to its own maintainer card). Rule: #35259 item 7.

Filing gate: ③ a task the maintainer dispatched. Child of epic #35152, beside #34780. Reader: the maintainer (a live model key; the lane's containers are keyless). Dedupe: open `eval-run` cards for door mode — none.

Grade: p2 · area:cloud · Task · inherits #34780's grade

## Why

#34780's build landed: PR #35241 (`02a1e2f29c5`) adds `os-scenarios --modes door` with a skills arm and a rules arm. The card's done-when needs one live round, which no fleet container can run (no model key). #34780 itself stays open only for the rules-corpus port, which is fleet work.

Maintainer-action: run one door-mode round at five repetitions per arm (skills on/off, named rule set on/off; the command is in `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`, door mode section) and file it as an `eval-run` — done when an `eval-run` record for door mode at five repetitions per arm is linked on this card.

## Note

If the round runs before #34780's corpus port lands, the rules arm reads a rules file supplied at run time (see #34780 comment 6988054411).
